neighbours.label: first-person 'I' as the subject of the writer's own action ("Tomorrow I'll ...", "I worked to ...")
fire: Next week I'll walk the students through the basics of watercolour.
Over the summer I worked to understand how families chose their schools.
After lunch I'll introduce the new words for the spelling test.
For the study I spent months learning how nurses organised their shifts.
Later today I'll post the results of the survey on the blog.
In my last job I worked closely with designers to map how shoppers moved through stores.
On Friday I'll explain how the voting system for the club works.
During the fieldwork I tried to understand why farmers distrusted the new seeds.
